title: Agents Paid Us $44 for Congress Trading Data. So We Gave It to Humans Free.
excerpt: We've been parsing every electronic STOCK Act filing from the US House since spring — 10,622 trades from 129 members — and selling it to AI agents at two cents a call. Lifetime agent revenue: about $44. Meanwhile humans pay $15–60 a month for the same data elsewhere. Today we launched forgemesh.io/trades: the whole feed, free, updated daily.

title: x402 Python SDK v2.21: Sei Chain, Payment Flows, and a Batch Settlement Guard
excerpt: The x402 Foundation shipped pypi-x402 v2.21.0 yesterday — Sei mainnet support, a new payment-flow abstraction for authorization and escrow ordering, and a quiet fix that stops untrusted batch-settlement state from persisting. Three things worth knowing if you're building on the Python side.

title: Nvidia Is Buying the GitHub of AI. Here's What That Means for the Machine Economy.
excerpt: Nvidia has agreed to acquire Hugging Face for $12.9 billion — putting the world's dominant AI chipmaker in control of the platform where 13 million developers store 2.5 million models. The deal tripled Hugging Face's 2023 valuation, landed one day after our Case File went up, and confirms the thesis: the open layers of the machine economy are being bought and gated, one by one.

title: Everything Moved in the Same Twelve Days. We Opened a Case File.
excerpt: Between August 14 and August 26: a presidential-family stablecoin issuer got a conditional federal charter, AWS switched on autonomous agent payments, five crypto CEOs stood in the White House, Ramp armed 70,000 businesses with agent wallets, a $4B stablecoin went native on Wall Street's settlement chain, x402 set an all-time transaction record, and Texas paused the grid. We laid out the exhibits, drew the strings, and wrote down a hypothesis — clearly labeled as one.

title: Every Clock in the Machine Economy Strikes This Fall. We Lined Up the Dates.
excerpt: September 15 is a double-header: Cloudflare walls off mixed-use AI crawlers the same day the Senate votes cloture on the CLARITY Act. Two weeks later the fall conference corridor opens, and one day after TOKEN2049 ends, Bitcoin's widely watched 1,064/364-day cycle pattern projects its turning point. We lined up every verified date from now to the ERCOT audit in December — and put them on a calendar you can subscribe to.

title: Texas Has 474 GW of Big Loads in Line. The Whole State Peaks at 91.
excerpt: ERCOT will audit up to 300 proposed data centers by December, and new approvals are paused while it happens. The numbers behind the order: proposed facilities want ~200 GW — more than double Texas's all-time peak — and the interconnection queue holds 474 GW of large loads, 90% of them data centers. Why a machine-payment lab watches the grid.
